headline: No API change affects the bot today, and only two scanner ideas held up: show how close each mover is to its 7-day high, and tag trades that fade a sharp 15-minute spike, because new research says that bounce is too small to pay your fees.

ideas.title: "Near the high" number on each scanner card
ideas.why: A 2023 study found that, in liquid coins, being close to the recent high predicted the next move better than the raw % gain. Show "0.6% under 7d high" on each card from data the scanner already pulls, and only add it to the score if backtest.py shows it helps.

ideas.title: Tag "fade" trades and show their results in /week
ideas.why: A 2026 study of Binance 15m candles found sharp, taker-driven moves do bounce a little, but the edge (~1.3 bp) is far below a 5 bp round trip and gone within 4h. Tag entries that go against the last big 15m candle so /week shows if fading spikes costs you.

sources.title: Fičura (2023), Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal (FFA Working Papers)
Kitron & Wengrowicz (2026), Short-horizon mean reversion in cryptocurrency markets: a matched cross-market measurement (arXiv)
Zaremba et al. (2021), Up or down? Short-term reversal, momentum, and liquidity effects in cryptocurrency markets (RePEc)
Wu & Pinsky (2026), Lagged momentum and reversal strategies across daytime and overnight sessions in Bitcoin and Ethereum (JRFM)
How to spot bull and bear market traps in crypto before they catch you (Cointelegraph)
